description: far negative x: tiny but normal outputs and gradients.
reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.mish(x), (x,), grad_out) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: atol 0 in both tolerances (stricter than the defaults, which would accept 0 here): outputs and gradients are tiny but normal. Values around -3 (softplus) and -2.25 (mish) sit on both sides of where Polypous switches from a series to the plain formula. Expected values are PyTorch's (autograd) in f64 on the f32 tensors, rounded once to f32; PyTorch's own f32 result meets tolerance and gradient_tolerance (checked by the generator).
